description: Patch table and cylindrical-coordinate electrostatic map of the human LONP1 hexamer
code:
import os, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
from sklearn.cluster import DBSCAN
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT=os.getcwd(); PDB="7NG5"
d=pd.read_pickle(f"{OUT}/{PDB}_atoms_sasa.pkl"); dots=np.load(f"{OUT}/{PDB}_dots.npy")
P=np.load(f"{OUT}/{PDB}_phi150.npy"); A=np.load(f"{OUT}/{PDB}_dotarea.npy")
O,axis=np.load(f"{OUT}/{PDB}_axis.npy"); prof=np.load(f"{OUT}/{PDB}_prof.npy")
xyz=d[["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].values
def cyl(p):
    z=(p-O)@axis; r=np.linalg.norm((p-O)-np.outer(z,axis),axis=1); return r,z
dr,dz=cyl(dots)

# ---- patch table, per-protomer (restrict to one chain to avoid symmetry duplicates) ----
tree=cKDTree(xyz)
m=P>0.6; lab=DBSCAN(eps=3.2,min_samples=15).fit_predict(dots[m])
sub=dots[m]; sA=A[m]; sP=P[m]; sr=dr[m]; sz=dz[m]
L1={'ARG':'R','LYS':'K','ASP':'D','GLU':'E'}
rows=[]
for L in range(lab.max()+1):
    k=lab==L; a=sA[k].sum()
    if a<400: continue
    near=set()
    for i in tree.query_ball_point(sub[k],5.0): near.update(i)
    rr=d.iloc[sorted(near)].drop_duplicates(subset=["auth_asym_id","resi"])
    b=rr[rr.label_comp_id.isin(["ARG","LYS"])]; ac=rr[rr.label_comp_id.isin(["ASP","GLU"])]
    ext=sub[k]-sub[k].mean(0); sv=np.linalg.svd(ext,full_matrices=False)[1]/np.sqrt(k.sum())
    rows.append(dict(patch=L, area_A2=round(a), mean_phi=round(sP[k].mean(),2), max_phi=round(sP[k].max(),2),
        area_x_phi=round(a*sP[k].mean()), r=round(sr[k].mean(),1), z=round(sz[k].mean(),1),
        dims=f"{2*sv[0]:.0f}x{2*sv[1]:.0f}", nbasic=len(b), nacid=len(ac), net=len(b)-len(ac),
        dom=rr.dom.value_counts().index[0], nchain=rr.auth_asym_id.nunique(),
        basic=",".join(sorted({f"{L1[x.label_comp_id]}{x.resi}" for x in b.itertuples()}, key=lambda s:int(s[1:])))))
pt=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("area_x_phi",ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
pt["loc"]=np.where(pt.r<16,"axial channel","outer surface")
pt.to_csv(f"{OUT}/LONP1_7NG5_positive_patches.csv",index=False)
pd.set_option("display.width",300); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",90)
print(pt[["patch","area_A2","mean_phi","max_phi","area_x_phi","r","z","dims","nbasic","net","dom","nchain","loc"]].head(14).to_string(index=False))
print()
for i in range(6): print(f"P{pt.patch[i]} [{pt.dom[i]}, {pt.loc[i]}] {pt.basic[i]}")

# ---- figure ----
fig,axs=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,6.6),gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[1.5,1]})
ax=axs[0]
o=np.argsort(np.abs(P))
s=ax.scatter(dr[o],dz[o],c=P[o],s=1.2,cmap="coolwarm",vmin=-2,vmax=2,rasterized=True)
plt.colorbar(s,ax=ax,label="screened-Coulomb surface potential (kT/e, 150 mM)")
for _,p in pt.head(8).iterrows():
    ax.plot(p.r,p.z,'ko',ms=5,mfc='none')
    ax.annotate(f"P{int(p.patch)}\n{int(p.area_A2)} $\\AA^2$",(p.r,p.z),fontsize=7.5,
                textcoords="offset points",xytext=(5,4))
ax.axvline(16,ls='--',c='0.4',lw=1); ax.text(16.6,-105,"r = 16 $\\AA$\n(axial channel)",fontsize=8,color='0.3')
for zb,lbl in [(49,"NTD / NTD-CC"),(10,"NTD-CC / AAA+"),(-47,"AAA+ / protease")]:
    pass
ax.set_xlabel("distance from hexamer 6-fold axis, r ($\\AA$)")
ax.set_ylabel("position along axis, z ($\\AA$)   [NTD up, protease down]")
ax.set_title("Human LONP1 hexamer (PDB 7NG5): surface electrostatics\nin cylindrical coordinates")
ax2=axs[1]
dommap={"NTD":"NTD 123-370","NTD-CC":"coiled-coil 371-414","AAA+":"AAA+ 415-758","PROT":"protease 759-949"}
cols={"NTD":"#4C78A8","NTD-CC":"#E45756","AAA+":"#72B7B2","PROT":"#B279A2"}
owner=np.load(f"{OUT}/{PDB}_owner.npy"); ddom=d.dom.values[owner]
for k,v in dommap.items():
    kk=ddom==k
    ax2.hist(P[kk],bins=np.linspace(-2.5,2.5,60),histtype="step",lw=1.8,density=True,label=v,color=cols[k])
ax2.axvline(0,c='0.5',lw=0.8)
ax2.set_xlabel("surface potential (kT/e)"); ax2.set_ylabel("density of surface dots")
ax2.set_title("Potential distribution by domain")
ax2.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
